\begin{proposition}[Structure after compensation]
\label{ctrl:structure-proposition}
Suppose the generalized input is realized exactly, the residual energy is twice continuously differentiable, and the implicit branch is locally unique. If $\delta\gamma=0$, the map defined by \eqref{ctrl:midpoint} is exact symplectic, with central generator $S_\Delta^c=\Delta h_c$. If $\delta\gamma$ is constant and nonzero, the exact map of \eqref{ctrl:weighted-midpoint} instead satisfies
\[
 (D\Phi_c)^{\mathsf T}JD\Phi_c=e^{-\delta\gamma\Delta}J.
\]
The latter conclusion is a statement about the weighted scheme, not the ordinary controlled midpoint rule.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[Conditional discrete persistence for the compensated catheter]
\label{kam:map-theorem}
Assume the conservative realization in Proposition~\ref{ctrl:structure-proposition}, real analyticity of the true and learned residuals, the domain and chart bounds in \eqref{kam:closed-budget}, and a unique analytic branch of the exact implicit map. Suppose the nominal frequency map satisfies uniform twist bounds
\[
 \iota\norm v_\infty\le\norm{D_I\omega_0(I)v}_\infty
                \le\Theta\norm v_\infty,
 \qquad0<\iota\le\Theta.
\]
Choose $0<\Delta\le1$, $\tau_D>3$, and
$0<\gamma_D\le\min(1,\rho_I\Theta/2)$,
where $\rho_I$ is the complex action radius. Retain the frequencies satisfying \eqref{kam:map-divisors} at distance at least $2\gamma_D$ from the frequency-domain boundary. If the constants and the reduced analytic domain satisfy the smallness inequality
\begin{equation}\label{kam:map-smallness}
 C_3\epsilon_c+C_4\Delta^p
       \le\delta_0\gamma_D^2\iota^2\Theta^{-3},
\end{equation}
with the $\delta_0$ of the analytic map theorem, then $\Psi_\Delta^c$ has the corresponding Cantor family of invariant quasiperiodic tori. A positive-measure family additionally uses the frequency-domain geometry and measure hypotheses of that theorem.
\end{proposition}

 \det\bigl(C_\alpha D\Phi_Z+D_\alpha\bigr)\ne0.

\caption{Disposition of principal numerical claims after changing
the material inputs, endpoint inertia and modal maps. The complete
chapter-level register accompanies the source package.}

\toprule
Earlier component & Current treatment & Work required for a new numerical claim\\
\midrule

FE frequencies and balanced maps & Recomputed at $16/32/64$ elements & Higher-mode forced trajectories remain a separate validation task.\\

Full-beam torus lift and persistent-control bounds & Conditional construction; no new full-order simulation & Recompute higher modes, tail forcing, input bounds and startup transients.\\
Governor, operational tolerance and S-path results & Conditional arguments; old outputs excluded & Reinitialize and implement the corresponding controllers and reserves for the new model.\\

lies inside the allowed angle and actuator domain, it is an invariant
two-torus of \eqref{app:full-modal}. For each fixed low-mode orbit on
this torus, higher-mode deviations decay exponentially while the
closed-loop trajectory remains in that domain.
\end{proposition}

\[
 (D\Phi_c)^{\mathsf T}JD\Phi_c=e^{-\delta\gamma\Delta}J.
\]
后一结论针对加权格式，不针对普通受控中点格式。
\end{proposition}

\begin{proposition}[补偿后导管的条件性离散持续存在]
\label{kam:map-theorem}
假设命题~\ref{ctrl:structure-proposition} 中的保守实现条件成立，真实残差和学习残差实解析，式 \eqref{kam:closed-budget} 中的定义域与坐标图界成立，且精确隐式映射有唯一解析分支。设标称频率映射满足一致的扭转矩阵界
\[
 \iota\norm v_\infty\le\norm{D_I\omega_0(I)v}_\infty
                \le\Theta\norm v_\infty,
 \qquad0<\iota\le\Theta.
\]
选择 $0<\Delta\le1$、$\tau_D>3$，以及
$0<\gamma_D\le\min(1,\rho_I\Theta/2)$，
其中 $\rho_I$ 为复作用量半径。保留满足式 \eqref{kam:map-divisors} 且距频率域边界至少 $2\gamma_D$ 的频率。若相关常数及缩小后的解析域满足小量不等式
\begin{equation}\label{kam:map-smallness}
 C_3\epsilon_c+C_4\Delta^p
       \le\delta_0\gamma_D^2\iota^2\Theta^{-3},
\end{equation}
其中 $\delta_0$ 取自所用解析映射定理，则 $\Psi_\Delta^c$ 具有相应的拟周期不变环面 Cantor 族。正测度族的结论还需要该定理关于频率域几何与测度的假设。
\end{proposition}

\toprule
物理量 & 数值 & 依据与解释\\
\midrule
梁长 $L$、半径 $r$ & $80$ mm、$0.6$ mm & 均匀实心梁的指定几何尺寸。\\
杨氏模量 $E$ & 约 $2.1$ MPa & Sylgard 184 材料参考值，制备条件见正文 \citep{cho2021pdms}。\\

裸磁芯边长 $a_m$ & $0.250$ mm & 指定的立方磁芯设计；不计涂层和胶黏剂。\\
剩余磁通密度 $B_r$ & 标称值 $1.425$ T & N50 牌号范围 $1.40$--$1.45$ T 的中点 \citep{smN50}。\\
磁芯密度 $\rho_m$ & 标称值 $7500\,\mathrm{kg\,m^{-3}}$ & 取制造商声明的规格下限；并非单个磁芯的密度实测值 \citep{smN50}。\\
轴向偏置场 $B_0$ & $30$ mT & 设计选值；已发表的 OctoMag 实验提供了 $40$ mT 矢量磁场能力的参照 \citep{lussi2021cvs}。\\
第一模态阻尼比 $\zeta_1^{\mathrm{d}}$ & $0.025$ & 有效阻尼情景，相对于包含端部惯量的偏置场下频率定义。\\
有效中心线净空 $c$ & $4$ mm & 设计比较值，已从通道半宽中扣除杆半径。\\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table*}

有限元频率与平衡映射 & 已在 $16/32/64$ 个单元下重新计算 & 高阶模态受迫轨迹仍需单独验证。\\
匹配条件下的实数／复数 CHNN 拟合及训练随机种子对比 & 作为历史结果；本文用明确声明的双标量测试替代 & 生成新数据，执行完整的匹配训练与验证协议。\\
GC17 中点法／Central4 表 & 不采用历史数值 & 重新拟合目标能量，并在该函数上重复两种积分测试。\\
COMSOL 全有限元、两模态与模型失配比较 & 不采用历史数值 & 重建每个独立模型、输入、求解器协议及降阶比较。\\
有限振幅 KAM、族／测度与尾项证书 & 保留条件性理论；不采用旧数值证书 & 重新计算拟合函数、解析域、Gram／缺陷界、扭转、环面及经验证的余项不等式。\\
全梁环面提升与持续控制界 & 保留条件性构造；没有新的全阶仿真 & 重新计算高阶模态、尾项强迫、输入界及启动暂态。\\
输入功约束器、运行容差与 S 形路径结果 & 保留条件性论证；不采用旧输出 & 针对新模型重新初始化并实现相应控制器及裕量。\\
长期与共振边界诊断 & 不采用历史输出 & 重新执行所述时域、采样、延拓及收敛研究。\\
